responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_expand/src/mbe/diagnostics.rs: Provides macro-by-example specific diagnostics for matcher and expansion failures. It reruns macro matching with tracking to identify the furthest failure point, formats parse and fragment-kind error messages, and attaches macro-context notes and suggestions such as missing commas, doc comment explanations, and invocation/arm span labels. compiler/rustc_expand/src/mbe/macro_check.rs: Statically validates `macro_rules!` metavariable usage across matchers and transcribers. It tracks binder declarations and repetition environments, checks for duplicate or free metavariables, verifies that occurrences repeat under compatible Kleene operators and nesting, and performs best-effort checking of nested macro definitions while buffering the corresponding lints and errors. compiler/rustc_expand/src/mbe/macro_parser.rs: Implements the core macro-by-example matcher as an NFA-style parser over flattened matcher locations. It transforms matcher token trees into traversable states, advances matching threads against invocation tokens and parsed nonterminals, detects ambiguities and syntax failures, and produces the named metavariable bindings used by expansion. compiler/rustc_expand/src/mbe/macro_rules.rs: Coordinates definition-time compilation and invocation-time expansion of `macro_rules!` macros. It owns the expander for compiled arms, drives argument parsing and arm matching through the matcher/parser infrastructure, invokes transcription of the selected RHS, enforces fragment follow-set and complete-parse checks, and emits macro-specific recovery, lint, and tracing behavior around expansion. compiler/rustc_expand/src/mbe/metavar_expr.rs: Defines and parses `${...}` meta-variable expressions used in macro transcribers. It recognizes supported operations such as `concat`, `count`, `ignore`, `index`, and `len`, validates their token-level syntax and depth arguments, rejects unsupported identifiers or trailing tokens, and exposes traversal over referenced metavariables for later checking and expansion. compiler/rustc_expand/src/mbe/quoted.rs: Parses generic token streams into the internal macro-by-example token-tree representation used for both matchers and transcribers. It recognizes metavariable declarations and uses, repetition sequences with separators and Kleene operators, nested delimiters, and meta-variable expressions, while enforcing fragment-specifier validity, feature gates, and syntax restrictions that differ between macro patterns and bodies. compiler/rustc_expand/src/mbe/transcribe.rs: Performs macro-by-example RHS transcription by expanding the selected rule with the matched metavariable bindings. It walks nested token-tree and repetition frames, substitutes bound nonterminals, evaluates meta-variable expressions like `count` and `concat`, applies expansion hygiene marks to produced spans, and reports repetition-shape or metavariable misuse errors discovered during emission.
